action.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(CASE WHEN a.type = 'Revenue' THEN g.credit - g.debit ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN g.account_id = '5000' THEN g.debit - g.credit ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN a.type = 'Revenue' THEN g.credit - g.debit ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON g.account_id = a.account_id WHERE g.entity_id = 'CA01' AND g.period IN ('2026-01', '2026-02', '2026-03')
